_desc: Work history — one object per role, most recent first. Home shows the first 3 compactly; /work shows all in full (tech chips + bullets).
_sources: Internship certificate from Astha Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (dated 14/07/2026): 'Machine Learning Engineer Intern', 19th May 2026 to 13th July 2026. CONFIRMED by Mit (2026-07-17): show only verified certificate facts — location, technologies, and highlights stay empty by decision, and the UI omits those blocks when empty.

_fields.isCurrent: true = green '● Working' badge and 'Present' end date.
_fields.location: Long form, e.g. 'Surat, India (On-Site)' or 'Remote (India)'. NEEDED.
_fields.technologies: Tech/tool names used in this role. NEEDED.
_fields.highlights: 'What I've done' — 3-5 factual bullets. NEEDED (certificate wording is generic).
_fields.companyUrl: Optional link for the company name.
_fields.logo: Optional; reference v2 shows no logos.
